integrity: Complete proof, precise reduction and two standalone executable finite verifiers included; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved for labelled cycles of order 3k+1 with k>=2 and minimum maximal matchings only. Earlier bracelet classification is credited; the precise all-vertex eccentricity is the contribution. Equivalent unindexed graph-metric results remain possible; no independent scholarly audit.
title: Every minimum maximal matching of a cycle of order \(3k+1\) has eccentricity \(\lfloor(3k+1)/2\rfloor\)
